warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain & Oil Dilution
paragraphs: Discovery Sport D165 models with the Ingenium 2.0-litre diesel — that's the L550 generation from 2020 onwards — share the well-documented Ingenium diesel pattern of timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, and EGR components as standard on every D165 rebuild.
